title: GSE Joint Cyclic Gap Simplex stable-phase corrective readiness
purpose: Requalify JCGS after the first three-seed run exposed an undefined low-resultant atan2 backward path that could produce a non-finite bearing and CUDA gather failure.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training numerical-stability requalification over the exact V3 population/rows; no checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated autonomous best-method choices and requested continuous execution without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed first JCGS three-seed system failure.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: No fit. Re-audit all C01-C08 metadata and the exact eight deterministic real rows.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Repeat V3 readiness and explicitly test zero/low phase-resultant backward, non-finite bearing rejection and pre-optimizer non-finite gradient rejection.

teacher.source: Sealed continuous exit bearing/width/profile plus local axis and global geometry.
teacher.use: Unchanged cyclic phase/gap/geometry losses; no identity.
teacher.valid_mask: Unchanged exact peak, width and global geometry masks.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid images only for eight real rows.

split.historical_pollution_audit: The failed run supplies only failure evidence; no checkpoint initializes any model.

methods.main: Keep ordinary atan2 forward values but bound its backward denominator at float32 phase-mass machine precision; reject non-finite bearings before periodic gather and non-finite gradient norms before optimizer steps.
methods.baseline: V1 training: seed0 completed; seed1 produced CUDA scatter/gather out-of-bounds during epoch4 after earlier finite checkpoints, before selection.
methods.fallback: If origin/low-resultant gradients, fail-closed checks or any V3 method contract fails, stop JCGS before retraining.

acceptance.stable_phase: Forward equals ordinary atan2 away from the singularity; zero-resultant gradients are finite and zero; low-resultant gradients are bounded.
acceptance.fail_closed: Non-finite bearing is rejected before gather and non-finite gradient is rejected before optimizer step.
acceptance.joint_set: Singleton 360-degree closure and all V2/V3 phase/gap/symmetry/real-backward checks remain PASS.

failure_policy: Fail closed. Do not resume V1. PASS authorizes only a full from-scratch V1R training Data Card.
retention: Retain regression log, repeated readiness evidence, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU metadata audit plus eight-row forward/backward
